class.name: SteamRelayRequest
class.brief_description: One exact request to the game's trusted hosted relay coordinator.

method.name: get_kind
method.description: Return the native hosted step, registration or authorization.

method.name: get_profile
method.description: The operator-defined hosted relay deployment profile.

method.name: get_listing_id
method.description: The exact generation-scoped hosted locator. The coordinator must use this same value to register and withdraw.

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: The Steam AppID selected and validated by the native SDK.

method.name: get_namespace
method.description: The matching game's namespace, bound to the selected hosted locator.

method.name: get_server_steam_id
method.description: The expected certified Steam GameServer identity as a decimal SteamID64.

method.name: get_virtual_port
method.description: The exact Steam hosted virtual port, from zero through 65535.

method.name: get_registration_id
method.description: The generation nonce as a decimal unsigned 64-bit string. The backend signs this value into the relay ticket's [code]crimson_registration[/code] fixed64 extra field.

method.name: get_world_id
method.description: The authority's mounted world during registration. Empty during client authorization.

method.name: get_login_blob
method.description: Copy the Steam-signed server login blob on the scene thread before dispatching backend work. Send it only to the authenticated coordinator backend. Empty off the scene thread, during client authorization, or after settlement.

method.name: get_local_steam_id
method.description: The signed-in client's candidate SteamID64. The coordinator independently authenticates the caller before using this value. Empty during registration.

method.name: is_cancelled
method.description: Return true once the owning Game abandoned this exact request.

method.name: registered
method.description: Acknowledge registration of the exact signed server login. If the Game cancelled, the request withdraws that same registration. [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] means the backend must compensate itself.

method.name: authorize
method.description: Return a fresh signed Steam relay ticket of 1 to 4096 bytes for this exact client, AppID, authority, virtual port and registration. Crimson verifies the SDK-parsed fields and cache selection before opening any peer.

method.name: fail
method.description: Settle the pending request without a registration or authorization. A settled or unconfigured request returns [constant ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE].

constants.constant: No native Game owns this request.
Authenticate and register the exact server login with the trusted coordinator.
Authenticate the current client independently and sign a ticket for the exact server registration.
